Wacker Chemie AG officially opened a new specialty silicone production facility in Karlovy Vary, Czech Republic, in June 2026, which manufactures room-temperature-curing silicones and solid silicone rubber targeting growth sectors including medical technology.

Wacker Chemie AG completed a major capacity expansion program across its global network, expanding liquid silicone rubber (LSR) capacity at its Adrian, Michigan plant in 2023, and introducing high-consistency rubber (HCR) and specialty silicone manufacturing at sites in Panagarh (India), Plzeň (Czech Republic), and Tsukuba (Japan).

Wacker Chemie AG announced the launch of SILPURAN eco 2114 at the COMPAMED 2025 trade show, a biomethanol-based silicone gel adhesive designed for the fixation of medical wound dressings, wearables, and monitoring patches.

In May 2024, Wacker Chemie completed the acquisition of Bio Med Sciences' assets and technology to transition into a vertically integrated solution provider of silicone-coated healthcare patches and medical device adhesive coatings.
